title: Bitwise OR of Adjacent Elements
summary: Given an array nums of length n, return an array answer of length n - 1 where each element answer[i] is the result of the bitwise OR operation between nums[i] and nums[i + 1].
statement: Given an array nums of length n, return an array answer of length n - 1 where each element answer[i] is the result of the bitwise OR operation between nums[i] and nums[i + 1].
constraints: For every adjacent pair nums[i],nums[i+1], compute their bitwise OR.
Return these n-1 results in index order.
The input contains at least two values.
reference_solution:
def adjacent_bitwise_or(nums):
    return [a|b for a,b in zip(nums,nums[1:])]
hints: Zip nums with its one-position suffix to enumerate adjacent pairs.
Apply bitwise OR to each pair.
Collect results in the same order.
The zip creates exactly pairs (0,1) through (n-2,n-1), so no adjacency is missing or duplicated.
editorial: The zip creates exactly pairs (0,1) through (n-2,n-1), so no adjacency is missing or duplicated.
